components.text: An OpDefinition is not a hard-coded if-else chain. It declares match, accepted, and compile; ScopedCompiler searches the current scope for the longest and most specific combination.

pages.text:
• rune(name): matches a named rune such as arrow or engaging.
• op(type): matches a compiled child operation such as MomentumOp.

• boundary(role): matches a child operation with a boundary role.
• rawGroup(role): matches a failed child group that remains raw.

$(f:minecraft:uniform)match   = required inputs
accepted = additional inputs the op may consume
compile = turns the match into a CompiledOp$(/f)
